title: Every .sufr fixture is read by a test and reproduced by mk_test_files.py
body: Batch 2 of sufr-25f57e. create_bytes_match_fixtures covers 13 of 16 fixtures in data/expected. 1d.sufr is version 4 and unreadable, 1m.sufr fails to open, 1s.sufr has no reader: each is covered or deleted. mk_test_files.py passes --write-lcp so a regeneration reproduces the committed bytes (sufr-c9b319). A fixture built with -m so the LCP under -m is pinned by bytes. The decision on the 12 create_* tests is on the parent.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/1ddc0e5b
notes.text: Open item three decided on 2026-11-03: the twelve create_* tests are deleted in c9c880d. create_bytes_match_fixtures and libsufr/tests/header.rs cover what they checked. The bytes test still stops at the first differing fixture; reporting every differing fixture is a separate change under this issue.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/1ddc0e5b
notes.text: mk_test_files.py and the Makefile were deleted in 56db6ff on Jack's instruction. The fixture review is sufr-bf8c3b, which replaces this issue's remaining scope.
